_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. frame.io declares its design-token layer in the site's stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): the theme-invariant scales under core.* (the grey/brand/alpha palette, the spacer scale, the grid, the durations and easings, the z-index map) and the painted roles under dark.* — the site's one theme, measured on the live pages and aliased to the declared variables whose values match. accounts.frame.io's sign-in surface is a different stack; its measured values live under component.productShell.* as literals.

gothic.source: css-var --font-main declared on .__variable_9d88cd (raw/css-vars.json); the probe cannot resolve a class-scoped declaration
gothic.description: FrameGothic — every display heading on the site (a 400-600 variable face with an Arial-metric fallback), declared as --font-main.

machina.source: css-var --font-secondary declared on .__variable_5c99cd (raw/css-vars.json); the probe cannot resolve a class-scoped declaration
machina.description: NeueMachinaInktrap — labels, kickers and the mono-flavoured UI type, declared as --font-secondary.

inter.description: Inter — body copy and UI text (a 100-900 variable face), declared as --font-tertiary.
